skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the concept of office, functions, tasks, role of office in business enterprises.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Understanding the structure of office organization
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the structure of office organization, forms, principles of organizing offices, modernization trends.
Understand types of office labor, their functions, tasks, standards, recruitment, training, and development methods.
Organize basic office operations such as information work, meetings, conferences, travel arrangements for leaders and organizations.
Manage document work including classification, procedures for incoming and outgoing documents, seal management, and secret storage devices.
Draft various types of administrative documents such as reports, circulars, proposals, notifications, minutes, and contracts.
Manage time effectively for office staff.
Develop communication skills for phone calls, meetings, conferences, and travel.
Apply critical thinking to solve problems related to office management.
Continuously learn and improve office management skills.
